title: BisectDoc
description:
The `--bisect-json` document (schema 1). A run that ended without a verdict
(refused, or an error) carries `error` and no `rootdir`/`cwd`.

culprits.description:
The culprit test ids, in the order they run before the victim. Empty
when the victim is not order-dependent or the run ended without a verdict.

error.description: Why the run ended without a verdict (absent on a completed bisect).

nodeid.description: The victim test's node id, relative to `rootdir`.

order_dependent.description: Whether the victim fails only after the culprits run first.

reproduce_command.description:
A command that reproduces the failure, or `null` when the victim is
not order-dependent.

rootdir.description: The pytest rootdir the node ids are relative to.

BisectMeta.description: Envelope metadata for the bisect document.
